questions.question: What was the original name of Disney's Hollywood Studios when it opened in 1989?
In what year did Disney-MGM Studios (now Hollywood Studios) open at Walt Disney World?

decision: The pair supply the 1989 opening event and Disney-MGM Studios name in reverse. Retain q618; the requested old name is already given there. Neither needs both directions of the same opening-event identification.

evidence.locator: Opening sentence gives May 1, 1989 and original Disney-MGM Studios Theme Park name; final paragraph gives 2008 renaming.
